pull.title: seeds: drop 21.ninja as a makeseeds source
pull.body:
The seeds.txt.gz file was last generated on 2026-05-22 (as per the comment in the first line and the most recent entry). This is about 6 months old now, and probably 10 months when used for the next release. There is no point in feeding (mostly) stale addresses into makeseeds.py and keeping the domain around just risks someone else getting access to the host or domain to insert malicious or fake addresses into it.

My understanding is that the owner of 21.ninja stepped away from Bitcoin development and probably will not maintain the seeder going forward. I'm reaching out to them directly and ping them in a comment below. Happy to close this if they come back and plan to keep maintaining the seeds.

Also dropping stale documentation about sipa's seed (removed in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35691) being used for makeseeds.

events.body:
ping @virtu! Do you plan to maintain this going forward or can it be dropped?

---

This leaves us with only one source for the fixed seeds. I know @willcl-ark is also running a seeder that can be used for this. I'll leave it up to him if he wants to add his seeds.txt.gz here.

The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36818 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36818#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. A summary of reviews will appear here.
